summary: Scope review for iteration `authenticated-dashboard-shell` succeeded. The current stories, elaborated requirements, and test design are consistent with the delivery objective: protected `/dashboard` routing, Home as default content, collapsible left navigation with Home/Feedback Request/Configure, top-right user identity and logout to `/`, icon-only light/dark theme toggle, and non-browser verification. Scope is properly bounded away from Feedback Request Excel upload/batch creation, public feedback form, implemented Configure behavior, registration profile changes, welcome-email changes, browser execution, deployment, and publishing. Technical readiness is acceptable: prior registration and welcome-email prerequisites are implemented in source; current `/dashboard` absence and existing `/` post-auth redirects in `src/app/sign-in/page.tsx` and `src/app/register/actions.ts` are expected delivery work, not blockers. Checks passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`, and `npm.cmd run lint`. Browser verification, Playwright, e2e tests, app server startup, production build, deployment, and publishing were not run per task constraints.
